notes.title: Development progress - Chapter 0 and more
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
For whoever is here in our private "Rewrite - DYH" community, we want to thank you for your support.
We are deeply grateful for it.
As it has been half a year since our last "News" post, we thought to share with you a little progress report:

As a team of 2 people it was no simple task (especially while working and studying), but we managed to finish developing "Chapter 0" (excluding music) of our new game - [b]Chameleon - DYH[/b].
So what is this new game? Imagine "Rewrite - DYH" only x10 more interactive, complex and adaptable, while still keeping its beautiful charm. 

Only thing is that we now think it would be better to release 2 chapters in a row instead of one. So we should expect a little delay in release including development, debugging and extending game-play capabilities.

Nevertheless, expect something EXTREMELY UNIQUE!
We are making plans to benefit "Rewrite - DYH" players, so whoever is reading this, please stay tuned and share your love or opinions of the game. 
Best regards
DYH
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306316/0befecddf31cc48e1eece499ac398669bed143e6.gif[/img]

notes.title: 🌠 Rewrite - DYH: Available now for SteamOS + Linux & Windows!
notes.content:
We are celebrating the new SteamOS + Linux release with new Easter Eggs and a new Library Capsule!

Seeing people enjoy the game and sharing their experience has been a dream that has come true 🌟 Thank you for all the love and support.

Make sure to stay healthy and strong. 

More projects are already planned ahead, so stay tuned everyone. 

Side note: Ubuntu users may install the following additional dependencies to permit them to play the game: libcurl4, libopenal1
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38306316/6b0bef69e67223991ece08c896863a0d66bfce6b.jpg[/img]
